steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: How long has it been since you were last here, Director Saria?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Going a little spacey?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's not like you... Thinking about the test site?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Do you remember Haydn 1 laboratory?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course I do. That's where Ifrit's from, right? We even investigated that place together.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've been to several hundred similar ruins since.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's very risky to work with the military. Rhine Lab hides behind layers of contracts and conducts these dangerous experiments with other laboratories doing the dirty work.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: But this time, Ferdinand chose to charge into the fray himself.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That tells us Rhine is one careless move away from turning into one of those ruins.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If he fails... Ferdinand will end up buried under the ruins too, right? His real cause of death won't even hit the papers.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Ferdinand has no way out of this anymore. He has no choice but to make sure this experiment succeeds.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Are you worried about Silence and the gang?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm only analyzing the risks.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh, I thought you were more honest than that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Okay, okay. She'll be fine. She's a lot stronger now than she used to be, just to look out for Iffy.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Are you consoling me, Director Muelsyse?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That's unnecessary.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've never doubted Silence's and Ptilopsis's abilities. They will assume their own responsibilities, and so will we.

options: We will work with each other.
You're showing more of a human touch, Saria.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did I ever mention that I've always really admired the way Rhodes Island works?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: My, you really have a way with words. Makes me want to jump ship and hop over.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Right, right? You feel the same.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I knew I wasn't mistaken.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Multiple power armor signals approaching.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, the Liberi merc is catching up to us.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Perhaps she's been waiting nearby.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, are you sure Kristen is here?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Saria's right. Ferdinand can't take this failure, but we don't have time for trial and error, do we?

options: Ferdinand doesn't want to let anyone find Control.
There's only one place that's in his full control.
There's only one place to hide from prying eyes.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Rhine Lab headquarters.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So that's the place that checks the most boxes, huh?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: After I lost contact with Kristen, I went to her home, the test sites, and all her favorite spots...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Everyone who works at Rhine knows Control doesn't like to hang around the office.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Every day, a bunch of staff members ask where she is, but who knew that she could be right there under our noses?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Scan complete.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, it's just as you thought. There is a large group of armed militants guarding all exits on all floors.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Rhine HQ must already be under Ferdinand's control.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We need to make our moves carefully, and I'm including both Muelsyse and myself.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Seize them.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dammit...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What are you blanking for?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: All units, we've got a situation at the labs' entrance. It's a Pioneer and a Rhine researcher... Mrgh!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: In the end, we still gotta hurt people.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's self defense. I'll testify for you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: There's an emergency exit to the left. Run that way! We'll talk after we make it out—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Someone's coming!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Get ready!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wait, you again?!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: M-Miss Elena...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I didn't hurt you, did I?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm fine. I figured you'd strike, so I braced myself.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: All of you, stay right where you are.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Mary Banner of the Trimounts City Police Department.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We're taking a kidnapping and assault suspect into custody. I'd appreciate your cooperation.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Suspect?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Mary...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You're a hard one to catch. Isn't that right, 'Team Leader?'

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Drop your weapons and put your hands up.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Right hand too.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Put your right hand up, please.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A syringe?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hold on, what are you trying to do?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: This is a physical examination.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: There might be a hazardous material leakage in these laboratories. Regulations demand we execute prevention procedures on all personnel.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: May I take a look at the medicine you're administering?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: The situation is critical. Please don't get in the way.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Warning: Procedure does not match existing records.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What you are doing is completely against the rules...

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Rules? I don't need a researcher who was... kicked out of Rhine to teach me about rules.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What about me, then?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Do I have the right to ask you to turn this syringe over?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Franks...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I am the overseer of Site 359. State your objectives immediately.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Sorry, Director Franks, but Director Clooney has taken over responsibility for all your site's functions.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Without his orders, you can't ask us about our operation.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If I recall correctly, only Control can change an experiment's overseer.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What gives Ferdinand the right to overstep his bounds?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: I can't answer that.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: This should be enough...

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Mission complete. All units, pull out.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: They're gone...?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Affirmative. The Defense Section personnel are quickly evacuating the site.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I thought they were here to take the Pioneers away... Am I mistaken about Ferdinand?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Ferdinand!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Ugh...!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Dr. Silence, all Pioneers who received injections have lost consciousness.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Tend to them immediately!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Franks, do you know how to administer emergency treatment... Director Franks?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Ma'am, I thought we were here to save Mr. Sonny...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Don't think you can change my mind with a couple of sentimental words!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You got my letter...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Trying to win my sympathy only works once, Romano.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I'm just glad I didn't let you get away. Otherwise, who knows what kind of surprises I'd have waiting for me?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You don't trust me...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Why should I?!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Four years ago, you didn't want to go to the quarantine zone. I trusted you, and helped you lay low—

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then how did you turn around and thank me?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I was outta my mind! My Oripathy plus my insurance premiums drove me nuts. I had no other...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You broke into my place and forced me to give you everything worth half a dime—Just for your goddamned insurance premium! You thought they'd let you back into your law firm if you paid it!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You know how much that scared Nana? Did you know she's been bedridden ever since? Remember how she doted on you, even more than she did for her own granddaughter?!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And how about this? After you got spooked and ran off, I was so worried the cops would find you, do you know what I went through to cover it all up for you?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You don't know anything.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You're a cold-blooded, selfish criminal. I should never have been so soft on you...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Officer!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It doesn't matter what kind of bad blood you two have with each other. We need to get out of here, otherwise—

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: He kidnapped you, and you're making his case for him?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Listen to me. The real problem is with Rhine Lab...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: This shaking...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Uh... Is that coming from inside?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy's lab...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Run!!!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: It... actually happened...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Such intense tremors... occurring across a large area... Is it a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, not a Catastrophe. It's the lab...
In the center of the laboratory cluster, a fissure appears on what should have been an exceedingly sturdy building.
It wasn't caused by the tremors.
The building is being torn apart from its deepest parts.
Something is breaking out of its shell, bit by bit, and unbelievably quickly.
In just an instant, half its floors are engulfed.
Above the rubble, the silver object starts bringing the entire site into its embrace.
The newly-born, colossal object gracefully twists its geometric figure and coldly stares down at the people on the ground.
None of this is beyond her comprehension.
She understands the principles behind all this, and she's calculated all the possibilities.
Yet she still forgets to breathe and blink, and she forgets all about the trembling earth beneath her feet and the roaring gusts all around.
Her dream has evolved from a blueprint and a word of promise to a reality.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: How beautiful...
But also terrifying.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Get down—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You were in tremendous danger... If you were just one inch closer, you would've been crushed by the bricks!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: It's too late...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What is?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Doctor, you failed to stop me. My experiment... succeeded.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Clooney! What's happening at the laboratories—

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You are frightened.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Frightened...? Haha, of course not. I'm just overwhelmed with emotion at these results! I... I'm truly happy for you and Director Franks.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Your teeth are chattering.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Ha... haha...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Perfect.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Fearing such great unknowns is an instinct of the weak.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: You're right. Before your results, our enemies... Columbia's enemies will tremble in fear!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You're talking about terrorizing our enemies?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: That's what the army men worry about all day and night. They give me the funding, and I give them the weapons—We scratch each other's backs, and that's where it ends.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: But you did remind me...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's time to move to the next phase.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Wouldn't that provoke it...? What about the people at the site?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: They're making the greatest sacrifice of all.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Remember their names.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: As pioneers in the truest sense, their names will go down in history.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Their fearlessness gave birth to this ferocious beast, and we will take control of it and make it ours. It will be our hands and eyes.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Just as our ancestors, the brave settlers, brought burdenbeasts under their control, enabling civilization to conquer the wilderness.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: We, too, will conquer this beast created by technology and expand mankind's reach into even greater unknowns.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: —We will be the trailblazers who expand the frontiers of civilization.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Are... are these the silver monsters? How did they grow so big...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We'll need something special to do any damage!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You goddamned—monster!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Did you see those arrows?
The three arrows, all shot at different times, approach the silver geometric figure in a tidy row. The farther they fly, the slower they get, all the way down to an immeasurable crawl.
Yet they remain suspended in the air.
Enveloped by the silver light, they disappear from sight at the very same moment.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: So the monster's got some magic tricks?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It disintegrated them.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But it seems awfully quiet to me...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Watch out! Move!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Urgh... Was that an energy beam, or some crossbow bolts? Where did it come from...? It was so quick, I couldn't catch it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Logic can't explain its movements and attack patterns.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Perhaps... to that thing, moving and attacking are one and the same...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Supposing this really is the... final product of Dorothy's experiment, then the whole site is within its range of perception.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If the idea crosses its mind, it could modify the physical properties of all objects within that range, instantaneously.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Or, in plain Victorian, we're like modeling clay for a kid to play with, is that right?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: More or less.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We need to stop attacking it, Officer. Otherwise, it'll level the whole site within minutes!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wait, you wouldn't happen to...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I wouldn't happen to have a bunch of explosive-equipped drones, would I?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Keep dreaming!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: So what about those people from Rhine Lab...? Are they here to help us deal with the experiment?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Do you remember what I just said?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: About it leveling the whole site?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's already begun...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Am I seeing things? Did that crane... turn into a perfect sphere?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: It won't be long before it hits the quarters, too!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Dammit! If this site goes down... Trimounts... not to mention the other cities are still in the dark.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: They don't even know a monster made by some stupid frickin' eggheads is about to roll them up into a ball!

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: We need to get out of here right now.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Get the word out...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We need to get the word about this out. He's known for a long time it would come to this.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Who? Who's behind all this? Who'd take it this far? Dorothy Franks?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, it's not her.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: —It's a man who's made a fool out of me for a long time now. Someone who's really taken me for a ride.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: He wants to erase the Pioneers... and everything that's happened here at the site.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: And all of Rhine Lab might be on his side.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: The police were probably bought off, too.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'd bet good money there's no media outlet ready to report on this.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Miss Elena, you know who we should get word out to.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'll find Dr. Silence. This is the most crucial objective of our operation.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But you'll be trapped here... Your lives might even be in danger!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I trust Dr. {@nickname}, and you too.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I know we can do this.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You trust me...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What can I do...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The observation station... I have to get to observation.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Need a ride?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The transport over there...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I borrowed it from Rhine.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: It so happens I need to go back and nab the real bad guy behind all this. You're going the same way, aren't you?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Mind if I tag along?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No matter which way we slice this... Officer, I'm a suspect in your custody...
Mary doesn't answer, but she extends her hand to Sonny nonetheless.
Beside her, Elena does the same.
Sonny takes their hands and climbs onto the transport, its engine already running.
The three of them—a police officer, a Pioneer, and a researcher—speed toward the edge of the site together.
The sandstorm behind them gives chase in vain, unable to stop their escape.
